whatIsIt.eli5: The model already gives one answer per thing, so no clean-up is needed. It just keeps the top answers.
whatIsIt.simple: End-to-end models (YOLOv10, YOLO26) use a one-to-one head trained to give one prediction per object. Inference keeps the top-scoring predictions (up to 300) without NMS.
whatIsIt.engineer: One-to-one branch + top-k selection (max_det = 300); no IoU-based suppression.

whyExists.eli5: Skipping clean-up makes the time more steady, which helps small devices.
whyExists.simple: Without NMS, speed does not depend on how many objects are in the picture, and the whole model can be exported as one graph.
whyExists.engineer: Deterministic latency and simpler deployment (no NMS plugin); trained with consistent dual assignment.

eli5: Keep the best ones, up to 300.
simple: The one-to-one head gives each object one strong prediction.
Keep the top-scoring ones above the confidence threshold.
engineer: During training the one-to-many head still supervises shared features; at inference only the one-to-one branch is read.
